name: MiBelleza
description: Uruguayan online store selling only L'Oréal group brands: skincare, makeup, fragrances, hair care and personal care. Prices in UYU.
description_es: Tienda online uruguaya que vende únicamente marcas del grupo L'Oréal: skincare, maquillaje, fragancias, cuidado capilar y personal. Precios en UYU.

ships_to.notes: Home page mentions shipping to all Uruguay with cost and time calculated in the cart; no dedicated shipping page found

search.notes: The search page loads, but results did not appear in the HTML; they probably render with JavaScript.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.
Plain-text faq-ai.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

shopping_notes: Catalog is limited to L'Oréal portfolio brands; other brands are sold by LOi (a separate listed store). robots.txt allows crawlers, with a crawl delay and disallowed checkout and account paths.

sources.supports: home page: brand scope, categories, UYU prices
